::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Thiruvananthapuram edge-AI chip firm founded 2020 (Jyothis Indirabhai, Deepa Geetha, Sreejith Varma) and the only firm with two PDLI projects. Its NETRA A2000 (12 TOPS, TSMC 12nm) achieved silicon bring-up and launched in May 2026 for customer trials; commercial production is targeted for late 2026–27.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Edge-AI SoCs and chiplets: NETRA A2000 (12 TOPS) and R1000 (1 TOPS edge MCU), plus C1000/C2000 parts for video analytics and vision.
